```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Code for the manuscript submission "Biogeographic variation in reproductive strategy in a range-expanding marine gastropod" to the Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences. 

## Field Capsule Data Analysis 

### Load Packages 

Load packages required for downstream analyses. 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(multcomp)
library(nlme)
library(lme4)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
```

## Field-collected capsule analysis

Analyses for egg capsules collected in the field from two range-center sites (Cabrillo Beach and Rincon Point) and three range-edge sites (Muir Beach, Dillon Beach, Cape Mendocino). We ran generalized linear mixed models and linear mixed models for egg capsule and hatchling traits. 


### Hatchling Size 

Import data 

```{r}
hatchling_size <- read.csv("/Users/keiramonuki/Documents/Sanford\ Lab/snail_tank_experiment/field_data/hatchling_size.csv")

head(hatchling_size)

```

Check the data distribution, including the mean and standard deviation. 

```{r}
hist(hatchling_size$Hatchling_size)
```

```{r}
mean(hatchling_size$Hatchling_size) 

sd(hatchling_size$Hatchling_size) 
```

Run a GLMM with a gamma distribution and log link function and check AIC model fit. 

```{r}

hatch_size_gm <- 
  glm(Hatchling_size ~ Population + (1 | Aggregation_ID/Capsule_ID), family = Gamma(link = log),data = hatchling_size)

summary(hatch_size_gm)
anova(hatch_size_gm) 
Anova(hatch_size_gm)

AICc(hatch_size_gm) 
AIC(hatch_size_gm) 

```

Run pairwise comparisons in emmeans using Tukey adjustments. 

```{r}

em <- emmeans(hatch_size_gm, "Population", data = hatchling_size)
contrast(em, "pairwise", adjust = "Tukey")

```

Plot model residuals

```{r}
plot(hatch_size_gm)
plot(resid(hatch_size_gm))
hist(resid(hatch_size_gm))

```

Q-Q plot of residuals 

```{r}
qqnorm(resid(hatch_size_gm))
qqline(resid(hatch_size_gm), col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
```

Back-transform the model estimates to plot on top of raw data scatter. 

```{r}

emmeans(hatch_size_gm, "Population", type  = "response", data = hatchling_size)

estimates <- emmeans(hatch_size_gm, "Population", type  = "response", data = hatchling_size)

plot(estimates)

estimates


```

Create a dataframe of the back-transformed estimates. 

```{r}

site <- c("CB", "CM", "DB", "MB", "RP")

est <- c(0.611, 0.656, 0.664, 0.621, 0.621)


err_high <- c(0.623, 0.666, 0.675, 0.633, 0.631)


err_low <- c(0.600, 0.646, 0.653, 0.609, 0.611)


hatch_size <- data.frame(Population = site, Estimate = est, Error_high = err_high, Error_low = err_low)

hatch_size

```

Plot hatchling size across populations. 

```{r}
ggplot(hatchling_size, aes(x = Population, y = Hatchling_size, color = Population)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = Population, y = Hatchling_size), position=position_jitter(w=0.2), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("lightgoldenrod1", "darkgoldenrod2", "cornflowerblue","darkblue", "purple4")) +
  geom_point(data = hatch_size, aes(x = Population, y = Estimate), size = 4,  color = "red") +
  geom_errorbar(data = hatch_size, aes(x = Population, y = Estimate, ymin = Error_low, ymax = Error_high), color = "red", width = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_text(size=25), 
        axis.text = element_text(size=25),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 2),
        axis.ticks.length.y = unit(0.25, "cm")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Hatchling Size (mm)", expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1.2)) + 
  xlab("Population") -> hatch_size_plot

neworder = c("CB","RP", "MB", "DB", "CM")

hatch_size_plot$data$Population <- factor(hatch_size_plot$data$Population, levels=neworder)

hatch_size_plot

```

### Embryo size 

Import data

```{r}
embryo_size <- read.csv("/Users/keiramonuki/Documents/Sanford\ Lab/snail_tank_experiment/field_data/embryo_size.csv")

head(embryo_size)

```

Check the distribution of the raw data, including mean and standard deviation

```{r}
hist(embryo_size$Embryo_size)
```

```{r}
mean(embryo_size$Embryo_size) 

sd(embryo_size$Embryo_size) 
```

Due to the Normal raw data distribution, we will run a linear mixed effects model and calculate AIC values. 

```{r}
emb_size_lm1 <- lmer(Embryo_size ~ Population + (1 | Aggregation_ID/Capsule_ID), data = embryo_size)

summary(emb_size_lm1)

anova(emb_size_lm1)
Anova(emb_size_lm1) 

AIC(emb_size_lm1) 
AICc(emb_size_lm1)
```

Assess pairwise comparisons using emmeans and Tukey adjustments

```{r}
em <- emmeans(emb_size_lm1, "Population", data = embryo_size)
contrast(em, "pairwise", adjust = "Tukey")
```

Plot model residuals to assess model fit 

```{r}
plot(emb_size_lm1)
plot(resid(emb_size_lm1))
hist(resid(emb_size_lm1))
```

Q-Q plot of model residuals 

```{r}
qqnorm(resid(emb_size_lm1))
qqline(resid(emb_size_lm1), col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
```

Isolate model estimates to plot on top of the raw data scatter

```{r}

emmeans(emb_size_lm1, "Population", type  = "response", data = embryo_size)

estimates <- emmeans(emb_size_lm1, "Population", type  = "response", data = embryo_size)

plot(estimates)

estimates

```

Create data frame of the model estimates

``` {r}
site <- c("CB", "CM", "DB", "MB", "RP")

est <- c(0.324, 0.311, 0.304, 0.302, 0.294)


err_high <- c(0.335, 0.320, 0.313, 0.311, 0.308)


err_low <- c(0.312, 0.302, 0.296, 0.293, 0.281)


emb_size <- data.frame(Population = site, Estimate = est, Error_high = err_high, Error_low = err_low)

emb_size

```

Plot embryo size across populations

```{r}
ggplot(embryo_size, aes(x = Population, y = Embryo_size, color = Population)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = Population, y = Embryo_size), position=position_jitter(w=0.2), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("lightgoldenrod1", "darkgoldenrod2", "cornflowerblue","darkblue", "purple4")) +
  geom_point(data = emb_size, aes(x = Population, y = Estimate), size = 4,  color = "red") +
  geom_errorbar(data = emb_size, aes(x = Population, y = Estimate, ymin = Error_low, ymax = Error_high), color = "red", width = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=25), 
        axis.text = element_text(size=25),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 2),
        axis.ticks.length.y = unit(0.25, "cm")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Embryo Size (mm)", expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,0.6)) -> emb_size_plot

emb_size_plot$data$Population <- factor(emb_size_plot$data$Population, levels=neworder)

emb_size_plot

```

### Nurse Eggs

## Analyses for Lab-Reared Egg Capsules 

### Embryo Number 

Import data 

```{r}
embryo_number <- read.csv("/Users/keiramonuki/Documents/Sanford\ Lab/snail_tank_experiment/cap_len_emb_num_new.csv")

head(embryo_number)

```

Remove data from cold treatment and from RP population (not enough data for either), and the large DB snail (DB_H23)

```{r}
embryo_number %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "H") %>% 
  filter(Population != "RP") %>% 
  filter(Breeding_Pair != "23") -> embryo_number

head(embryo_number)

```

Check distribution of raw data, including mean and standard deviation

```{r}
hist(embryo_number$Number_embryos)
mean(embryo_number$Number_embryos)
sd(embryo_number$Number_embryos)

```

Run a GLMM with a negative binomial distribution, size and population fixed effects, breeding pair as a random effect, and a log link function. Calculate AIC values

```{r}
emb_num_nb <- 
  glm.nb(Number_embryos ~ Avg_Size + Population + (1 | Breeding_Pair), data = embryo_number)

summary(emb_num_nb)

anova(emb_num_nb) 
Anova(emb_num_nb) 

AIC(emb_num_nb)
AICc(emb_num_nb)
```

Back-transform model estimates to plot on top of the raw data scatter

```{r}

emmeans(emb_num_nb, "Population", type  = "response", data = embryo_number)

estimates <- emmeans(emb_num_nb, "Population", type  = "response", data = embryo_number)

plot(estimates)

estimates

```

Create data frame of the back-transformed model estimates

```{r}
site <- c("DB", "MB", "YB")

est <- c(45.9, 47.8, 43.6)
err_high <- c(49, 51, 47)
err_low <- c(43.0, 44.7, 40.5)

emb_num <- data.frame(Population = site, Estimate = est, Error_high = err_high, Error_low = err_low)
emb_num

```

Plot the number of embryos across populations

```{r}

ggplot(embryo_number, aes(x = Population, y = Number_embryos, color = Population)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(x = Population, y = Number_embryos), position=position_jitter(w=0.2), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("gold2", "cornflowerblue","darkblue")) +
  geom_point(data = emb_num, aes(x = Population, y = Estimate), size = 4,  color = "red") +
  geom_errorbar(data = emb_num, aes(x = Population, y = Estimate, ymin = Error_low, ymax = Error_high), color = "red", width = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
   theme(legend.position = "none",
         axis.title.x = element_blank(),
         axis.title.y = element_text(size=25), 
        axis.text = element_text(size=25),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 2),
        axis.ticks.length.y = unit(0.25, "cm")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Number of Embryos", expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,110))  -> emb_num_plot


neworder = c("YB", "MB", "DB")

emb_num_plot$data$Population <- factor(emb_num_plot$data$Population, levels=neworder)

emb_num_plot


```

Calculate pairwise comparisons using emmeans and Tukey adjustments

```{r}

em <- emmeans(emb_num_nb, "Population", data = embryo_number)
contrast(em, "pairwise", adjust = "Tukey")

#  DB - MB   -0.0398 0.0456 Inf  -0.872  0.6583
# DB - YB    0.0507 0.0544 Inf   0.932  0.6200
# MB - YB    0.0905 0.0547 Inf   1.655  0.2227

```

Plot model residuals to assess model fit 

```{r}
plot(emb_num_nb)
plot(resid(emb_num_nb))
hist(resid(emb_num_nb))
```

Q-Q plot of model residuals

```{r}
qqnorm(resid(emb_num_nb))
qqline(resid(emb_num_nb), col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
```

### Capsule Length

Capsule ength is in the embryo number dataset. Assess the distribution of the raw data, including mean and standard deviation.

```{r}
hist(embryo_number$Capsule_Length)
mean(embryo_number$Capsule_Length)
sd(embryo_number$Capsule_Length)
```

Run a GLMM with a gamma distribution and log link function and calculate AIC values.

```{r}
cap_len_gm <- 
  glm(Capsule_Length ~ Avg_Size + Population + (1 | Breeding_Pair), family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = embryo_number)

summary(cap_len_gm)
anova(cap_len_gm) 
Anova(cap_len_gm)

AICc(cap_len_gm)
```

### Growth Rate 

Adult snail growth rate in laboratory experiment

Import data

```{r}
growth <- read.csv("/Users/keiramonuki/Documents/Sanford\ Lab/snail_tank_experiment/growth.csv")

head(growth)

```

Remove NAs

```{r}
growth <- na.omit(growth)
```

Remove negative growth rates

```{r}
growth %>% 
  filter(Growth > 0) -> growth

```

Calculate summary statistics (mean, standard deviation, standard error), and save as a data frame

```{r}
growth %>% 
  group_by(Population, Treatment) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(Growth), 
            sd = sd(Growth),
            se = sd(Growth)/sqrt(length(Growth))) -> growth_summary


```

Plot by growth rates by population and treatment

```{r}
ggplot(growth_summary, aes(x = Population, y = mean, fill = Treatment)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean-se, ymax=mean+se), width=.2,
                 position=position_dodge(.9)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c('lightblue', 'brown1')) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor.y=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor.x=element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(size=25),
        legend.text = element_text(size=20),
        panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1), axis.title = element_text(size=35), 
        plot.title = element_text(size=20, face = "italic"),
        axis.text = element_text(size=25),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Growth Rate(mm/day)") + 
  xlab("Population") -> growth_plot


neworder = c("YB", "RP", "MB", "DB")

growth_plot$data$Population <- factor(growth_plot$data$Population, levels=neworder)

growth_plot


```

Run a linear model with a interaction between Population * Treatment * Sex and calculate AIC values

```{r}
growth$Population <- as.factor(growth$Population)

growth_lm2 <- lm(Growth ~ Population*Treatment*Sex, data = growth)

summary(growth_lm2)
anova(growth_lm2)
Anova(growth_lm2) 

AIC(growth_lm2)
AICc(growth_lm2) 

```

Plot model residuals to asess model fit

```{r}
plot(growth_lm2)
plot(resid(growth_lm2))
hist(resid(growth_lm2))
```

Q-Q plot of model residuals

```{r}
qqnorm(resid(growth_lm2))
qqline(resid(growth_lm2), col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
```

Calculate pairwise comparison using Tukey adjustments

```{r}

tukey_growth <- glht(growth_lm2, linfct = mcp(Population = "Tukey"))

cld(tukey_growth)
```
